title: Analog Channel
text: Construct loss model from channel loss metric or impulse response, 1 input, 1 output, {Specification} sets magnitude of near and far end aggressors; {Channel model} sets the source of channel, {Target frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency for desired channel, {Loss (dB)} sets the channel loss at target frequency, {Impedance (Ohms)} sets the channel characteristic impedance positive real, {Impulse response} sets the user provided impulse response, {Impulse sample interval} sets the sample interval of user provided impulse response, {Tx R (Ohms)} sets the single-ended impedance of transmitter analog, {Tx C (F)} sets the capacitance of transmitter analog model, {Rx R (Ohms)} sets the single-ended impedance of receiver analog, {Rx C (F)} sets the capacitance of receiver analog model, {Rise time (s)} sets the 20%−80% rise time of stimulus, {Voltage (V)} sets the peak-to-peak voltage at input of transmitter analog, {Include crosstalk}, {Far end crosstalk ICN (V)} sets the desired integrated noise level of far end aggressor, {Near end crosstalk ICN (V)} sets the desired integrated noise level of near end aggressor, {Symbol Time (s)} sets the symbol time of far end crosstalk stimulus, {Delay (s)} sets the delay offset of far end crosstalk stimulus, {Modulation} and {PRBS Order} sets the pRBS order of far end crosstalk stimulus. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Channel model
params.values: Source of channel model Loss model (default) | Impulse response

params.name: Target frequency (Hz)
params.values: Frequency for desired channel loss 20e9 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Loss (dB)
params.values: Channel loss at target frequency 8 (default) | scalar

params.name: Impedance (Ohms)
params.values: Channel characteristic impedance positive real scalar

params.name: Impulse response
params.values: User provided impulse response [zeros(1,63),1/SampleInterval,zeros(1,192)] (default) | matrix

params.name: Impulse sample interval
params.values: Sample interval of user provided impulse response 6.25e-12 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Tx R (Ohms)
params.values: Single-ended impedance of transmitter analog model 50 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Tx C (F)
params.values: Capacitance of transmitter analog model 100e-15 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Rx R (Ohms)
params.values: Single-ended impedance of receiver analog model 50 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Rx C (F)
params.values: Capacitance of receiver analog model 200e-15 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Rise time (s)
params.values: 20%−80% rise time of stimulus input 10e-12 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Voltage (V)
params.values: Peak-to-peak voltage at input of transmitter analog model 1 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Include crosstalk
params.values: Include crosstalk in simulation off (default) | on

params.name: Specification
params.values: Specify magnitude of near and far end aggressors 100GBASE-CR4 (default) | CEI-25G-LR | CEI-28G-SR | CEI-28G-VSR | Custom

params.name: Far end crosstalk ICN (V)
params.values: Desired integrated noise level of far end aggressor 15e-3 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Near end crosstalk ICN (V)
params.values: Desired integrated noise level of near end aggressor 10e-3 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Symbol Time (s)
params.values: Symbol time of far end crosstalk stimulus 100e-12 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Delay (s)
params.values: Delay offset of far end crosstalk stimulus 0 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Modulation
params.values: Modulation levels of far end crosstalk stimulus NRZ (default) | PAM3 | PAM4 | PAM5 | PAM6 | PAM7 | PAM8 | PAM9 | PAM10 | PAM11 | PAM12 | PAM13 | PAM14 | PAM15 | PAM16

params.name: PRBS Order
params.values: PRBS order of far end crosstalk stimulus 7 (default) | 9 | 11 | 13 | 15 | 20 | 23 | 31 | 47
